concept: Shared Rhythm — gathering, shared rise, resolve
meaning: Many responses gathering into one rising response to praise; a design metaphor, not official church doctrine or a mission statement.

stages.action: Distinct fine material voices approach through a quiet architectural space.
Filaments gather around an intentionally open forecourt; surfaces begin to unfold.
A coordinated rise reveals four lit folded planes as the camera pulls back.
Perspective and materials resolve into exact parish artwork; unaltered parent emblem and name appear.
The exact larger-emblem paired source artwork holds completely still.

method: Deterministic projected 3D vector geometry rendered through Canvas; no generated people or external generative video service.
originalEmblemBytes: Preserved only inside the exact final source composition, never involved in material transformations.
